title: Interpreter, Assertions, and Debugging Tools

details.note: Interpreter is a separate CPU debugging mode, not a GPU performance mode

analysis_en: All 4 documented debug operators were present. The retained GPU run validates the kernel; interpreter mode remains a separate CPU debugging workflow.
analysis_zh: 文档列出的 4 个调试操作均存在。当前保留的是 GPU 正确性运行；interpreter 是独立的 CPU 调试流程。
conclusion: Use interpreter and assertions to localize errors, then rerun correctness and performance on the target GPU.
